narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed in association with a frontal system moving through the region. Some of these storms produced a few tornadoes, hail, and damaging wind gusts.
ev: Flooding occurred in a few spots along Old Whitfield Road. White Blvd between the Country Inn and Suites and Business Center Parkway was impassable. There was an estimated 2.5 feet of water over the road.

Flash flooding occurred on St. Mary Street. There was around one foot of water at the intersection of State Street and Woodrow Wilson Ave. Many underpasses were flooded in South Jackson especially near the railways, with at least one car mostly submerged. There was flooding at the Live Oaks golf course area as well as along State Street and Meadowbrook. Holmes Avenue was flooded and impassable. Eubanks Creek was flooding out of its banks onto State and Choctaw Streets. Water was several feet deep, cars stalled, and homes with water inside.
Roads were blocked due to flash flooding.
Water flowed across roads in Florence.
A portion of Causeyville Road was under water.
Water ran over Pine Street and Heidel Road.
Water flowed across streets in Oak Grove.
Water was over roads in Magee.
A portion of Doc Webb Road was flooded.
